thread:
Marta Chen: Heads up — Sundial Finance's APAC pilot is blocked on onboarding tests; their integration tests are hitting 5xx from our ap-northeast-1 edge.
Marta Chen: They're in a renewal discussion next month and this is a high-risk unblock. Asking for a temporary QPS bump + IP allowlist for a few CIDRs so their test fleet can run.
Priya Nair: Can you post the customer ID, desired QPS, exact IPs/CIDRs, and how long they need it for? Prefer expire timestamp so we can auto-revoke.
Marta Chen: Customer: sundial-finance (acct SF-7721). Requesting 1500 QPS in ap-northeast-1 for a 72h window starting now. IPs:
```
13.45.23.1/32
13.45.23.2/32
3.112.56.8/32
```
Marta Chen: Quick reason: their end-to-end tests simulate production load; currently failing on connection errors. If we don't unblock, renewal conversation will get noisy.
Adeel Khan: I can provision a soft QPS bump + allowlist on the proxy side. Will need eng-sre to patch the regional rate window and infra to push the peering ACLs. Auto-revoke at 2025-06-01T18:00:00Z ok?
Marta Chen: That timestamp works — thanks. Also please add a note on the ticket for renewal-touch follow-up.
infra-bot: Created ticket INC-8342 for temporary QPS/allowlist; assignees: @Adeel, @Priya. SLA: same-business-day.
Priya Nair: Copying steps we'll run (for audit):
1) update rate-window for ap-northeast-1 for SF-7721 to 1500 QPS (soft, no billing change)
2) add 3 IPs to proxy allowlist for SF-7721
3) add /32s to peering ACL on the peering gateway
4) schedule auto-revoke at expire timestamp and add alert if usage spikes
Command I will run (dry-run shown):
```
POST /admin/v1/customers/SF-7721/rate-window
{
  "region": "ap-northeast-1",
  "qps": 1500,
  "mode": "soft",
  "expires_at": "2025-06-01T18:00:00Z"
}
```
Adeel Khan: Oncall note: I'll add a rate-limit override in the proxy config with a per-customer key. After Priya's patch, I'll confirm with this check:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_ADMIN" "https://infra-admin.internal/regions/ap-northeast-1/quotas?customer=SF-7721"
```
Theo Ruiz: I'll handle peering ACLs and CDN edge allowlist. Will also verify if any WAF rule is blocking their test client IPs. Adding a short ttl to the peering rule so infra-bot can auto-revoke.
Theo Ruiz: Peering command (will run once ticket is acked):
```
peeringctl allow --peer-id sfn-peer --cidr 13.45.23.1/32 --expires 2025-06-01T18:00:00Z
peeringctl allow --peer-id sfn-peer --cidr 13.45.23.2/32 --expires 2025-06-01T18:00:00Z
peeringctl allow --peer-id sfn-peer --cidr 3.112.56.8/32 --expires 2025-06-01T18:00:00Z
```
Priya Nair: Applied rate-window patch (soft) in staging; rolling to canary now. Will post canary logs in 10m and then apply to prod if stable.
infra-bot: INC-8342 updated: canary passed at 5219876890; scheduled prod push in 10m. Auto-revoke set to 2025-06-01T18:00:00Z.
Adeel Khan: Prod push done. Proxy shows SF-7721 quota = 1500 QPS. Quick smoke test from Sundial passed 3/3 requests. No 5xx observed in the last 5m.
Theo Ruiz: Peering ACLs and CDN edge allowlist updated. WAF rule that matched their dev user-agent was relaxed for the 3 IPs only.
Marta Chen: Amazing — I'll update Sundial and ask them to re-run the full suite. Also flagging renewal risks: please add a short summary to INC-8342 so renewal manager can see impact.
Marta Chen: Action items for CS: confirm full-suite pass, follow up with renewal manager, capture any perf numbers (p95 latency) to include in the renewal packet.
Priya Nair: Noted. Will attach post-change p95/p99 snapshots to the ticket in 30m.
Marta Chen: Thanks all :raised_hands: — please @mention me on INC-8342 when prod changes are live."
